tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: Search Yedapo's ~3,500 AI summaries of podcast and YouTube episodes. Matches words in the episode title, the show name, the summary's topic tags and its short teaser text (not full transcripts). Returns up to 10 matches, newest first within each match type, each with show, date, teaser, the episode

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get one episode's full Yedapo summary as markdown: teaser, should-you-listen verdict, key takeaways with timestamps, chapter breakdown, and the page URL to cite.
